title: CapsLock key beeps even after remapping to CTRL when Toggle Keys (Settings > Accessibility) is on

status.label: Recheck Toggle Keys behavior on current Windows and PowerToys
status.detail: A maintainer reproduced the beep and suspected Windows handles the physical Caps Lock before Keyboard Manager; a member still saw it on 0.85.1.

judgment.rationale: The report says Windows Toggle Keys beeps on physical Caps Lock even after Keyboard Manager maps Caps Lock to Ctrl, while the remapped Ctrl behavior itself works. A maintainer reproduced the beep and suspected that Windows processes the physical Caps Lock before Keyboard Manager can change it. A member reported the symptom still present in PowerToys 0.85.1. The actual Caps Lock toggle state and current stable behavior are not recorded.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.57.2 and Windows 10 with Toggle Keys enabled.
Caps Lock-to-Ctrl works for copy/paste, but Toggle Keys still beeps on the physical key.
A maintainer reproduced the behavior and suspected OS-first handling.
A member confirmed the beep remained on PowerToys 0.85.1.
The issue is open and marked Status-Reproducible; no linked fix was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on current stable and verify whether the OS toggles Caps Lock state as well as beeping; then determine whether the notification can be suppressed without changing Toggle Keys behavior.

fix_assessment.rationale: If the issue persists, Keyboard Manager may be unable to suppress the OS accessibility notification for the physical key before the hook receives it. Whether the beep can be prevented without a driver-level change remains unknown.

proposed_fixes.title: Avoid Toggle Keys responding to a remapped Caps Lock
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Windows Toggle Keys may observe the physical Caps Lock event before Keyboard Manager remaps it, causing a beep even though the application receives Ctrl.
plan: Reproduce on current Windows and PowerToys with Toggle Keys enabled and Caps Lock mapped to Ctrl.
Record whether Toggle Keys changes the Caps Lock state or only emits a beep.
Trace whether the physical event can be suppressed before the accessibility notification without a filter driver.
If the existing hook architecture cannot suppress it, document the limitation rather than changing the Toggle Keys feature or claiming a fix.
verification: Verify whether the beep and Caps Lock state change occur after remapping.
Verify Ctrl remains functional after remapping.
Verify Toggle Keys still reports genuine Caps Lock presses when Caps Lock is not remapped.

confidence.rationale: Maintainer reproduction confirms the symptom and suggests OS-first handling, but current behavior and whether the beep can be suppressed in the hook architecture are unresolved.

issue_context.summary: Toggle Keys beeps on the physical Caps Lock key after Keyboard Manager maps that key to Ctrl.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.57.2 and Windows 10 with Toggle Keys enabled.
Caps Lock-to-Ctrl works for ordinary Ctrl actions, but Toggle Keys still beeps.
A maintainer reproduced the symptom; a member reports it remains on 0.85.1.
inferences: Windows may process the physical Caps Lock event before Keyboard Manager remaps it, but the report does not confirm whether Caps Lock state changes or only the notification is emitted.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is confirmed but its expected OS interaction and feasibility of suppression are unresolved. Recheck the state effect on current stable before concluding whether this is a product bug or a platform limitation.
initial_investigation: Read the report and all three comments, including the maintainer's reproduction and the member's 0.85.1 confirmation.
No linked fix or pull request was found.

information_gaps.information: On current stable, whether Toggle Keys only beeps or also changes Caps Lock state when Caps Lock is remapped to Ctrl
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes an accessibility notification triggered by the physical key from a remapping failure and establishes whether suppression is feasible.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Enable Windows Toggle Keys, map Caps Lock to Ctrl, press Caps Lock on current stable, and check both the beep and resulting Caps Lock state.

actions.label: Reproduce Toggle Keys beep after Caps Lock remap

reproduce.title: Check Toggle Keys after remapping Caps Lock
steps: Press the physical Caps Lock key.
Observe whether Windows beeps and whether Caps Lock state changes.
Use Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V to confirm the remapped Ctrl behavior.
reproduce.expected_result: The physical key produces the configured Ctrl behavior without an unintended Caps Lock state change or Toggle Keys notification.

actions.label: Approve the Toggle Keys event-order investigation
